title: Vercel footer
description: A plain, roomy link directory on the page colour: groups of 14px links in a six-column grid (two columns on phones), each under a medium-weight ink title, with small grey pill badges beside new items. Under it a small ink mark, a blue mono status line with a dot on the left and a compact three-icon appearance switch on the right. Links darken from grey to ink on hover in 100ms.
notes: groups flow into six columns on desktop (wrapping into rows of six) and two on phones
the appearance switch is static UI: its buttons have no behaviour until you wire them
name: vercel-footer
